interpretation.label: crf_churn_selective_not_treadmill
interpretation.summary: With retirement made reachable, churn is SELECTIVE: extinct regularities are retired while still-recurring ones keep their slots (zero persistent retirements or re-mints), and the same substrate DOES produce the 666c treadmill at a higher dose. MECH-349 FALSIFYING(3) does not occur.

preconditions.name: ARM_FROZEN::mint_fires
preconditions.description: Worst cell in the arm mints >= 2 rules (a run with 0-1 live rules measures nothing). MECH-349 non-degeneracy (a).
preconditions.control: the arm's own worst cell; minting is not manipulated on any arm

preconditions.name: ARM_FROZEN::live_rules_present
preconditions.description: Worst cell in the arm ends with >= 2 live rules.
preconditions.control: the arm's own worst cell

preconditions.name: ARM_FROZEN::pool_not_saturated
preconditions.description: Worst cell's live rules stay strictly below n_slots, so mints are regularity-limited rather than slot-limited. MECH-349 (c).
preconditions.control: the arm's own worst (highest live/slots) cell

preconditions.name: ARM_FROZEN::mints_late_in_window
preconditions.description: Worst cell in the arm makes >= 1 mint in the FINAL THIRD of the window. MECH-349 non-degeneracy (c), first conjunct: a pool that fills in an early burst and then freezes has converted the asserted TRIGGERED creator into a one-shot INITIALISER, and its arm contrast is a dose contrast rather than a trigger contrast.
preconditions.control: the arm's own worst cell; persistent regimes are introduced on staggered onsets (the last at 0.75 of the window) so late minting is reachable

preconditions.name: ARM_FROZEN::anchor_retires_nothing
preconditions.description: ARM_FROZEN retires 0 rules, re-measuring the GFLAG-0265 structural fact that retirement is unreachable at maintenance_decay=0.0. If it ever retires, the framing this whole run rests on is wrong.
preconditions.control: the anchor arm itself; maintenance_decay=0.0 makes the leak a no-op

scope_finding_falsifying3_conjuncts_diss.statement: MECH-349 FALSIFYING(3) bundles three signatures: high minted, comparable retired, and pairwise distance at or near 0. The positive control here produces the first two in full while the third does NOT follow -- re-minted rules land back on the same well-separated regime directions, so tag-space distinctness stays high.
scope_finding_falsifying3_conjuncts_diss.implication: 666c's near-zero distance is a property of its UNCENTERED context key, not an intrinsic consequence of churn. Recorded for governance; not scored, and MECH-350 is NOT tagged.

lever_note.inert_lever: crf_maintenance_floor below crf_mature_retire_floor is INERT on its own: _maybe_mint sets init_avail = max(tolerance_floor, maintenance_floor), so a rule still mints at tolerance_floor (0.30), six times the 0.05 retire floor.
lever_note.rejected_lever: Lowering tolerance_floor too DOES retire (93/100) but degenerately -- every rule mints below the retire floor and dies on its first unprotected credit tick, MANUFACTURING the 666c signature instead of testing for it.
lever_note.lever_used: crf_maintenance_decay -- the only knob in credit() that touches a rule carrying no eligibility, and therefore the only one that can reach a rule that has gone silent.

structural_facts_not_measurements.distinctness_is_an_identity: crf_max_pairwise_rule_dist is a deterministic lookup on the live-rule SET off the pinned_seed=6063 matrix. Recorded for continuity with V3-EXQ-806's 1.598-1.711 only; a criterion for nothing here, and MECH-350 is NOT tagged.
structural_facts_not_measurements.global_churn_ratio_is_ecology_determined: MECH-349 non-degeneracy (b) asks for retired/minted <= 0.25. In an ecology containing extinct regularities that ratio is fixed by the ecology: a perfectly SELECTIVE creator retires exactly the extinct regimes, giving 0.50 -- it would FAIL the bar for behaving correctly. Recorded, not scored; the scored criteria are per-regime-class instead.

interpretation.seeds_are_reproducibility_not_power: Seeds vary only the common-mode offset and observation noise; regime directions are seed-independent, so the DVs are near-deterministic. The seed requirement certifies reproducibility and is NOT a significance test. The discrimination rests on the BETWEEN-ARM separation.
interpretation.arc062_seed_leg: NOT UNDER TEST. No arc062_seed is supplied at any call site, so MECH-349 non-degeneracy (d) is reported as untested, never as a null.
